verdict.rationale: GitLab's REST/GraphQL API (gitlab-docs-10) and CLI (gitlab-probe-3) enable scripted bulk actions across issues/MRs, and agent automation of repetitive tasks (gitlab-docs-12) supports at-scale operations, but no evidence explicitly documents a bulk-edit UI, bulk API endpoints, or AI-driven multi-item batch workflows. Missing for 10: explicit bulk-operation API/UI documentation, hands-on evidence of bulk actions working reliably, and AI-native tooling specifically designed for batch processing across many items.
